specs.title: home is local, responsive, and light on JavaScript
native navigation, questions, and reduced-motion simulation work
all public pages have working local links and unique metadata
guide keyboard navigation exposes the skip link and reaches main content
dated guides have visible sources, linked schemas and local-only page loads
language guides are linked, indexable and accurately describe shared models
content and native questions work with JavaScript disabled
